descriptionChirho: A demonstrative pronoun meaning 'this' or 'these,' used in various genders, numbers, and cases to point to something proximate or just mentioned. All three clusters are inflectional variants of the same deictic function: neuter plural (eng 'these things,' spa 'estas cosas,' hin 'ye baten,' arb 'hadha/hakadha,' kor 'igeotdeul,' swa 'haya'), dative feminine singular (eng 'to this woman,' spa 'a esta,' arb 'li-hadhihi'), and accusative feminine singular (eng 'this,' spa 'tal,' arb 'hadhihi,' swa 'mji fulani'). The pronoun functions identically across all forms as a near-demonstrative.
